name: LocalGov Microsites Colour Picker Fields
description: Adds a colour picker to certain fields on LocalGov Drupal Microsites.
project_description:
This module is currently developed on Github and mirrored here whilst projects from LocalGov Drupal are migrated to Drupal.org. Please file issues on the Github issue queue .

 Adds a colour picker to fields that define colours in the LocalGov Microsites distribution.
